settings.text:
Reduced §l§aSodium §fGl base !!! ------------------------------------------ 
CONFIGURE EACH PARTICLE ACCORDING TO YOUR PREFERENCE :

§pPotion particles §8: Emitted by players with beacon or conduit ambient effects, produced by area-of-effect clouds from lingering potions, emitted by players with non-ambient effects, and floats off tipped arrows.
settings.name: nic:spell

settings.text: §pPotion particles size §r
settings.name: nic:spell_size

settings.text: §pTotem particles §8: Produced when a totem of undying is used.
settings.name: nic:totem

settings.text: §pTotem particles size §r
settings.name: nic:totem_size

settings.text: §pBlock particles §8: Shown when sliding on honey blocks; produced by crafters ejecting items, lightning on oxidized copper/lightning rods, floats to ender chests, emitted by end rods and eyeblossom (night/day), from jukeboxes & note blocks, during Soul Speed walking on soul sand/soil, when scraping or waxing copper, and above mycelium.
settings.name: nic:blocks

settings.text: §pBreaking particles §8: Produced when blocks break, brushed, from long falls, sprinting, armor stand breaks, and when sheep eat grass.
settings.name: nic:breaking

settings.text: §pBubbles §8: Produced by entities at bubble column tops, shown in upward & downward bubble columns, from underwater splashes and projectile trails, by floating entities, underwater Eyes of Ender trails, and fishing bobbers.
settings.name: nic:bubble

settings.text: §pConduit particles §8: Appears and moves toward activated conduits, spawned by conduits attacking mobs, and travels toward hostile mobs targeted by conduits.
settings.name: nic:conduit

settings.text: §pCreaking heart particles §8: Trace a trail between two points. Shown when the creaking is attacked, to link it to its heart.
settings.name: nic:creaking

settings.text: §pCrit particles §8: Trails behind crossbow and fully charged bow shots, produced by evoker fangs, shown on critical hits, and when striking entities with Sharpness, Bane of Arthropods, Smite, or Impaling.
settings.name: nic:crit

settings.text: §pCrop particles §8: Appears when using bone meal on grass, flowers, moss, crops, or plants; when adding items to composters, bees pollinate crops, and when placing turtle eggs on sand or sniffer eggs on moss.
settings.name: nic:crop

settings.text: §pDeath particles §8: Left behind when a mob dies.
settings.name: nic:death

settings.text: §pDrips §8: Seeps from honey-filled beehives/nests, lava or water above blocks, drips from pointed dripstone (lava or water, filling cauldrons), off crying obsidian and wet sponges.
settings.name: nic:drip

settings.text: §pDust §8: Produced from water evaporating off wet sponges (Nether/dry biomes), and falls from floating concrete powder, dragon eggs, gravel, red sand, sand, unsupported scaffolding, and snow on leaves or floating.
settings.name: nic:dust

settings.text: §pEating particles §8: Shown when eating food; produced by slime jumps, turtle egg hatching, ice bomb breaks, foxes eating, wither creation, fireball/egg/snowball breaks, XP bottle, lingering & splash potion breaks, feeding mobs, and pandas eating bamboo.
settings.name: nic:eating

settings.text: §pEnchanting particles §8: Floats from bookshelves to an enchanting table.
settings.name: nic:enchanting

settings.text: §pExplosion particles §8: Produced by explosions, blocks destroyed by the Ender Dragon, and emitted by the Ender Dragon on death.
settings.name: nic:explosion

settings.text: §pFireflies §8: Spawns from firefly bushes when the internal light level is 13 or lower.
settings.name: nic:firefly

settings.text: §pFishing particles §8: Represents the fish trail when fishing.
settings.name: nic:fish

settings.text: §pFlame particles §8: Represents torch, soul torch, candle, and copper torch flames; shown in monster spawners, from lab table garbage, magma cube jumps, furnaces/blast furnaces/smokers while smelting, and floating around blazes during attacks.
settings.name: nic:flame

settings.text: §pHeart particles §8: Produced during mob breeding, shown when feeding or taming animals, and when allays duplicate.
settings.name: nic:heart

settings.text: §pLeaf particles (cherry) §8: Falls off cherry leaves.
settings.name: nic:leaves_cherry

settings.text: §pLeaf particles (pale oak) §8: Falls off pale oak leaves.
settings.name: nic:leaves_oak

settings.text: §pLeaf particles §8: Falls off the bottom of all leaf types except pale oak.
settings.name: nic:leaves_other

settings.text: §pMace particles §8: Produced by mace smash attacks.
settings.name: nic:mace

settings.text: §pMob particles §8: Shown when a creaking heart breaks, trails dolphins, phantoms, shulker bullets, guardians, emitted by ender dragon (breath/fireballs), glow squid, endermen/endermites, guardians' lasers, ravagers (stunned/roaring), llamas, pandas (sneeze), warden (sonic boom/emerge), left by silverfish, drips from pollinated bees, appears with villager hits, trades, breeding/job changes, feeding baby animals, and during the wither's birth/armor phase.
settings.name: nic:mobs

settings.text: §pPortal §8: Trails behind Eyes of Ender, appears when an Eye breaks, floats to broken Ender Pearls and teleporting dragon eggs, moves toward Nether/End Gateway portals (X & Z axes), and floats above respawn anchors.
settings.name: nic:portal

settings.text: §pRain splash §8: Appears when water drip particles or rain hit the ground, at bubble column splashes, shaken off by wolves, and from entities or fishing bobbers splashing in water.
settings.name: nic:rain

settings.text: §pRedstone particles §8: Emitted by redstone ore, powered repeaters, torches, and dust, and activated sculk sensors.
settings.name: nic:redstone

settings.text: §pSculk particles §8: Produced by traveling sculk charges, when a sculk charge pops, and appears over activated sculk catalysts.
settings.name: nic:sculk

settings.text: §pSculk shriek §8: Produced by activated sculk shriekers.
settings.name: nic:shriek

settings.text: §pSmoke particles §8: Displayed when failing to tame mobs; represents smoke from campfires (lit, extinguished, rain, on hay), candles, torches/soul torches, monster spawners, wither roses, end portals, brewing stands, and lava (incl. rain).
settings.name: nic:smoke

settings.text: §pSnowflakes §8: Produced by entities in powder snow.
settings.name: nic:snowflake

settings.text: §pSpawner particles §8: Appears when monster spawners spawn mobs, when ominous item spawners spawn items, when trial or ominous trial spawners activate, and when a player is near a vault.
settings.name: nic:spawner

settings.text: §pSpore §8: Floats around spore blossoms and drips from them.
settings.name: nic:spore

settings.text: §pVibration §8: Travels from a vibration source to a sculk sensor or warden, and from a note block to an allay.
settings.name: nic:vibration

settings.text: §pWind particles §8: Created when wind charges hit blocks, spawning gust particles, and produced/emitted by mobs with the Wind Charged effect.
settings.name: nic:wind
